name: Samut, Tyrant of Naktamun
description: An Echoverse wizard who rules Naktamun with the frozen god and can slow time to the point of freezing.

relations.quote: Hapatra's command over the hearts of Amonkhet's people is far deadlier than any threat Samut has faced before.
